pricing.title: Simple plans, no hidden fees
pricing.note: Prices are placeholders. Everyday banking starts free.

items.a: Deposits are held with a licensed partner bank and protected under the local deposit scheme. Ask support for the current limits.
Transfers between Lumen accounts are instant. Transfers to other banks usually arrive within a few hours.
The Everyday plan has no monthly fee. Plus and Joint have a monthly fee shown on the pricing page.

items.q: Can I use the card abroad?
items.a: Yes. Cards work worldwide, and the app shows the exchange rate before you pay.
Pick a rule, such as a fixed amount on payday or rounding up purchases, and Lumen moves the money for you.

items.q: What if I lose my card?
items.a: Freeze it in the app in one tap, order a replacement, and keep paying with the virtual card.

items.q: Can I open a joint account?
items.a: Yes, with the Joint plan. Both holders verify identity in the app.

items.q: Can I close my account anytime?
items.a: Yes. Move your money out and close the account from settings. No exit fee.
